caption:
The boarding queue was long, so Lulu rushed her suitcase into the overhead locker. She twisted as she lifted, and her back twinged.

Lifting a heavy bag far from your body while twisting can put extra load on your back. Keeping it close and lifting in two stages can ease that.

Hybi's tip: bag close, knees bent, pause at chest height, then push it in. Turn with your feet, and ask for help or check it in if it's heavy.

Pain spreading down a leg, tingling or weakness is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio
